basic_profile.bio: An avid financial literacy advocate based in Portland, Oregon. With a background in economics from a local college, I work as a lab technician by day and indulge in my passion for personal finance and credit management by night. I love helping others navigate the intricacies of credit scores and financial planning. Outside of Reddit, I enjoy exploring local coffee shops, practicing tarot, and engaging in casual meetups. I'm currently single and usually active on Reddit in the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in personal finance, primarily self-taught through books and online courses. My interest in credit management began when I started using credit cards actively and wanted to optimize my credit score. My work as a lab technician has honed my attention to detail, which I apply to understanding financial nuances.
